title: History of Prince Habib and What Befel Him With the Lady Durrat Al-Ghawwas

full_text:
Prince Habib of Oman, a youth trained in both chivalric horsemanship and sacred poetry, learned in a dream of the captivity of the Lady Durrat al-Ghawwas (Pearl of the Diver), a princess of the Sea Jinn who was held prisoner in the Iron Citadel on the Black Mountain by a malevolent sorcerer.

Vowing to champion her deliverance, Habib took up the legendary sword of his ancestors, the Blade of Light, and set out across stormy seas and desolate deserts.

Along his journey, Habib was tested by three monstrous perils:
First, he encountered the Serpent of the Scorched Pass, whose fiery breath burned armor; Habib used his polished shield as a mirror, blinding the monster with reflected sunlight and slaying it with a single thrust.
Second, he reached the Valley of Deceptive Echoes, where phantoms mimicked his mother's weeping voice; Habib stopped his ears with wax and rode forward without wavering.
Third, he crossed the Chasm of Shadows upon a bridge as narrow as a spider's thread, sustained entirely by his pure faith and unwavering purpose.

Reaching the Iron Citadel, Habib challenged the sorcerer to single combat.
The sorcerer transformed into a roaring black lion, then into a fiery dragon. But Habib, keeping his heart serene and his blade true, parried every magical assault and shattered the sorcerer's talisman of power.

The iron gates fell away, revealing Princess Durrat al-Ghawwas. Her beauty was like the full moon rising over calm ocean waters, radiant with gratitude and nobility.
She took Habib's hand and spoke:
'Prince Habib, many knights sought my freedom for gold and empire, but thou didst brave the abyss out of pure chivalry and honorable love.'

Together they traveled to Oman, where their union brought perpetual alliance between the kingdoms of the land and the kingdoms of the sea, ushering in an era of peace, oceanic trade, and shared wisdom.
moral: Chivalrous courage, steadfast devotion, and pure purpose conquer the darkest enchantments of the abyss.
